propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same epic's relation graph.
Empty ticket directories created by incomplete writes are invisible to git, persist in local clones, and cannot be detected by git status or fixed by pulling the shared history.
The plan-relation reducer walks the store directory listing and fails when encountering an event-less directory, even though such a directory carries no relation information needed by the snapshot.
The fix tolerates event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning naming the path, rather than failing the entire snapshot.
The writer continues creating the ticket directory before its first event to avoid unsafe concurrent cleanup in the multi-session store, and the reader-side tolerance fixes existing broken clones.
